items.title: Validate current-browser portability with named test evidence
items.body:
## Scope

Record named current-browser and operating-system evidence against an exact built artifact. Cover browser import, edits, verification off/on with bounded mocks, save/reopen, and encoded-payload proof where supported.

## Acceptance

- Record browser/OS versions, artifact version and SHA-256, test commands, and exercised formats.
- Separate passed, failed, and unrun surfaces; link actionable failures and retest evidence.
- Compare narrow/wide layout and current-browser file/download behavior without changing the portable architecture.

## Boundaries

This card is not a claim of universal browser or OS compatibility. No legacy-browser layer, new runtime dependency, or image upload is authorized.

[Current capabilities and evidence](https://chriscollins500.github.io/civitai-metadata-studio/trust/) · [Formats and limits](https://github.com/chriscollins500/civitai-metadata-studio/wiki/Formats-and-Limits)

items.title: Expand complex-workflow and custom-node regression fixtures
items.body:
## Scope

Add minimal, shareable regressions for specific loaders, switches, inactive branches, multiple outputs, and identity conflicts. Start with a reproducible supported-node question rather than scanning unrelated private libraries.

## Acceptance

- State expected positive/negative conditioning, active resources, output reachability, and unresolved diagnostics.
- Show fail-before/pass-after evidence for each parser change.
- Verify disabled, bypassed, disconnected, zero-strength, and unresolved dynamic branches do not become identity claims.
- Preserve original prompt/workflow carriers and encoded payloads during export/reopen.

## Boundaries

Use synthetic or explicitly approved public-safe fixtures. Names never establish model IDs; unsupported custom semantics remain visible uncertainty. No workflow rewiring or universal graph-coverage promise.

[Workflow guide](https://github.com/chriscollins500/civitai-metadata-studio/wiki/ComfyUI-Workflow-Handling) · [Learning examples](https://chriscollins500.github.io/civitai-metadata-studio/learn/)

items.title: Run a manual keyboard and screen-reader accessibility audit
items.body:
## Scope

Complement automated checks with keyboard-only and representative screen-reader sessions in named current environments, on both the project hub and the actual built editor.

## Acceptance

- Record browser, OS, assistive technology/version, artifact/URL, and tasks attempted.
- Check focus order/visibility/return, skip links, dialogs, ARIA tabs, form errors, live statuses, zoom/reflow, reduced motion, and export/reopen.
- Create concrete issues with minimal steps and retest corrected barriers.
- Distinguish observations from automated contract checks and untested combinations.

## Boundaries

This is planned validation, not completed certification or a blanket WCAG conformance claim. Preserve semantic controls and never require a mouse-only workaround.

[Accessibility scope](https://github.com/chriscollins500/civitai-metadata-studio/wiki/Accessibility) · [Report a barrier](https://chriscollins500.github.io/civitai-metadata-studio/community/)

items.title: Improve unresolved-resource explanations without guessing identities
items.body:
## Scope

Explore clearer source/evidence labels and actionable next steps when a resource cannot be positively identified. Review the proposed explanation model before changing behavior.

## Acceptance

- Distinguish missing evidence, unsupported role/type, ambiguous candidates, conflicting stronger identifiers, and provider cooldown.
- Show what exact evidence was considered without exposing private paths or prompt text.
- Offer explicit local hashing, exact-ID entry, or user-triggered search where applicable.
- Test wording and keyboard/screen-reader status announcements with representative synthetic cases.

## Boundaries

Exploration does not promise implementation. Never infer IDs from names, hide ambiguity, downgrade stronger conflicts, or equate identity with historical use or licensing permission.

[Identity rules](https://github.com/chriscollins500/civitai-metadata-studio/wiki/AIR-and-Hashes) · [Trust boundaries](https://chriscollins500.github.io/civitai-metadata-studio/trust/)

items.title: Evaluate explicit image/JSON sidecar pairing and conflict rules
items.body:
## Scope

Investigate a user-controlled association between selected browser images and selected JSON sidecars. Arbitrary browser JSON-sidecar auto-pairing is not currently implemented; CLI paired-sidecar regression coverage is not that feature.

## Acceptance

- Propose explicit association, batch filename/collision handling, precedence, conflicts, and provenance labels.
- Keep actual decoded pixel dimensions as editable defaults.
- Specify privacy, bounded parsing, original carrier preservation, and new-copy export behavior.
- Demonstrate safe synthetic ambiguous/mismatched pairs and document unanswered decisions before an implementation proposal.

## Boundaries

Exploration does not authorize filesystem scanning, hidden pairing, workflow rewriting, remote uploads, architecture changes, or a shipping commitment.

[Current limits](https://github.com/chriscollins500/civitai-metadata-studio/wiki/Capabilities-and-Limitations) · [Learning hub](https://chriscollins500.github.io/civitai-metadata-studio/learn/)
